mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fdq_controller WHERE plate_number = #{mainId} order by create_time desc limit 100

WITH max_kwh_car_data AS (SELECT PLATE_NUMBER, RUNNING_HOURS, KWH, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY PLATE_NUMBER ORDER BY KWH DESC ) AS rn FROM FDQ_CONTROLLER) SELECT SUM(RUNNING_HOURS) AS RUNNING_HOURS, SUM(KWH) AS KWH FROM max_kwh_car_data WHERE rn = 1;
select count(1) as COUNT_NUM, ORDER_TYPE from FDQ_ORDER GROUP BY ORDER_TYPE

select count(1) as COUNT_NUM, ORDER_TYPE from FDQ_ORDER where PLATE_NUMBER is not null
and CREATE_TIME like concat('%',#{startTime},'%')
GROUP BY ORDER_TYPE

WITH vehicle_latest_data AS (SELECT PLATE_NUMBER, KWH, CREATE_TIME, LAG(KWH) OVER (PARTITION BY PLATE_NUMBER ORDER BY CREATE_TIME) AS lastKwh FROM FDQ_CONTROLLER WHERE CREATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 2)), daily_data AS (SELECT PLATE_NUMBER, TRUNC(CREATE_TIME) AS createTime, KWH - lastKwh AS dayVolume FROM vehicle_latest_data), vehicle_daily_total AS (SELECT PLATE_NUMBER AS plateNumber, createTime, SUM(dayVolume) AS carDayVolume FROM daily_data WHERE createTime >= TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1) GROUP BY PLATE_NUMBER, createTime), date_total AS (SELECT createTime, SUM(carDayVolume) AS allCarDayVolume FROM vehicle_daily_total GROUP BY createTime) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN createTime = TRUNC(SYSDATE - 1) THEN allCarDayVolume END), 0) AS lastVolume, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN createTime = TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN allCarDayVolume END), 0) AS volume FROM date_total;
